title: Where Founders Can Bind Coverage Instantly
summary: Need startup insurance today? See how Corgi handles quotes, binding and certificates, what to prepare, and which details to confirm before you buy.
body_markdown:
We built Corgi around the moments when insurance becomes part of running a startup: closing a customer, raising a round, hiring a team or signing a lease. You can bring those requirements to us and review the relevant policies together, instead of working out the whole insurance package yourself.


[Intryc's founder, Alex Marantelos](https://www.corgi.insure/customers/intryc) , describes completing the application in five minutes and getting help from our team with packaged coverage choices.


[Eragon's founder, Josh Sirota](https://www.corgi.insure/customers/eragon) , says Corgi helped the company meet an enterprise customer's insurance requirements and close the contract in days.


That is the job we want to do well: make the requirements clear and help you get the right documents in place for the next step.
